name: vitals
description: KOZMOS Vitals: a btop-style machine monitor sidebar. CPU with a braille history graph, RAM bar and history, disk use, NVIDIA GPU load, memory and temperature, process count, and the Claude side: session time, tool calls, running agents. Samples every 2 s only while open. /vitals toggles it.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Vitals sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).
